image_description: Two pieces of rusted, textured metal armor plates (likely components of a breastplate or cuirass) resting on a solid yellow background. The piece on the right is upright and shield-shaped with visible rivets and a central vertical ridge. The piece on the left is lying on its side, showing a curved profile and attachment points. Both exhibit a heavy, pitted, corroded texture rather than polished steel.

The thickness of the metal edge on the left plate seems slightly inconsistent; the rim appears to vanish or become too thin in the middle section compared to the ends, which might indicate slight geometric warping.
